title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode8 Idol Troubles

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! You're leaving already?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I should really prepare for class tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. If you'd like to return to your world, just go to Untitled and press stop.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aw! If you tell them that, they're gonna leave!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's all right, Rin. Everyone goes home after a show ends.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-I know that, but still!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you Miku, Rin. It's been a while since I had this much fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See you later.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All you have to do to get here is play Untitled, so come back and visit whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Goodbye...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm going to head back too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? You too?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's like Miku said. Once a show ends, you go home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose I should get going as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Miku. Rin. Thank you for putting on such a wonderful show for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See you at school, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Momoi! Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wonder what's gotten into everyone. They all looked kind of sad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But they seemed to be having so much fun during the show...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't worry, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet they were just reminiscing about being idols.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: SEKAI is here to help you and the others discover your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So if things ever get tough, or if you or someone else is ever having trouble finding your feelings, come to SEKAI for a visit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: True feelings...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot! I need to go home and practice the steps I kept messing up today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Sorry Miku, Rin! I need to get going!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's all right, Minori.
Just remember to come visit whenever you need cheering up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll be right here waiting with another show just for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! We'll do our best to pick you up♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! And thank you both for today! I promise to come again, Miku! Rin!
Scramble Crossing

All that time I wasted... My dream of being an idol!
Give it back!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have no right to be an idol.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That show yesterday was the bomb...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning. Yesterday sure was strange, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Morning, Shizuku. You can say that again. With Miku and all that talk of another world...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Getting transported to another place by playing a song? How exactly does that work, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, you seemed to be enjoying yourself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I could see it in your face during the show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hey, Airi. Are you sure you don't still want to...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just because you want something to happen doesn't mean it will.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, you're well aware of why I quit being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Airi! You got an offer to appear on a variety show! It's during prime time, too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whaaat?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: One of the studio's executives happened to see one of your street performances. Apparently he was impressed with how well you spoke to the audience.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Finally, my big chance has come!
I'll have to work even harder!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I worked really hard after getting my first big break. I practiced public speaking and even did a ton of research on comedy sketches.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I was so happy when everybody started congratulating me for all my hard work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But then...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Airi, you received another request for a variety show appearance. Filming is next Saturday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What? Isn't that the day of the mini concert?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes, but the other members should be fine without you. We'll announce the change on our website.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: This will help get you more recognition, which will in turn increase the profile of the entire group. People who'd never heard of you before will start coming to your shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I...suppose that's true.
All right. In that case, I'll just have to keep doing my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If more people start to notice me, it'll help open up more opportunities for the whole group. Then we can put on shows for even more people.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I still feel really bad about letting down the fans who were looking forward to seeing me, though.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As an idol, I've got to give my all to the jobs I'm given!)
